name: Summit Pizza Co. (Garden City & Logan, UT) Oven-Baked Bone-In Chicken Wings (Plain / Mild BBQ)
brandOrRestaurant: Summit Pizza Co. (Garden City & Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Oven-baked wings have significantly less grease than deep-fried wings. Unbreaded, high-protein chicken that digests cleanly when ordered plain or with mild sauce.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order traditional bone-in wings plain or with mild sweet BBQ sauce on the side (avoid fiery buffalo sauce).
